checks.query: How are announcements and promotional materials broadcast across the SPUS campus?
checks.text:
Sure—here is the information from the stored sources.

PBMO broadcasts campus announcements and promotional materials via the Unified Multimedia Communication Network, which includes:

•
Outdoor campus LED displays
•
Campus TV monitors
•
Official SPUS social media channels
•
The university web portal

All promotional assets, announcements, and posters must undergo content and brand review by PBMO prior to broadcast or posting.
